newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK Prop to offer flats at HK$8,640/sq ft.
newsitem.headline: SHK Prop to offer flats at HK$8,640/sq ft.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd said on Wednesday it will offer the first batch of 36 units in King's Park Villa luxury residential development in Kowloon for sale on December 7 at an average of HK$8,640 per square foot.
Public registration for potential buyers will run from December 2-4, the company said.
King's Park Villa at King's Park Rise in Ho Man Tin will have total floor area of 474,123 square feet on completion of the development in March 1997, it said.

The development comprises six 21-storey residential blocks with a total of 342 units of 1,109 to 1,508 square feet, 18 duplexes with areas ranging from 2,086 to 2,465 square feet and a four-level car park.
Property analysts said pricing and response were expected to give an indication to the property market, especially the luxury residential sector in Kowloon.
